items.title: Mirrored Hourglass Tunnel DXF Panel for Optical Feature Walls
items.description: Concentric arched bands nest inward from both ends toward a shared center line, creating a striking hourglass tunnel illusion. The strong optical rhythm makes it a standout choice for feature walls and gallery-style dividers.

items.title: Modern Arched Grid Gate with Greek Key Accent Design
items.description: A clean, highly structural double gate design featuring a tight, secure square grid matrix. The arched top is adorned with elongated oval loop patterns, while the lower section features a sophisticated Greek Key (meander) geometric border resting above an elegant intersecting circle base.
